text_block_list.text:
I go looking for Mihono Bourbon after
she
doesn't show up to training, and find
her in the
cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Season to taste? How many milliliters of

seasoning is "to taste"?

text_block_list.name: Lunch Lady
text_block_list.text:
However much you think is tasty! Just
put in as
much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I have a report. I have
confirmed that
the apple dish they serve
at lunch helps me
recover from fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Believing that it would aid my future
activities, I
examined the recipe, but I'm
having trouble with 
terms that
frequently appear, like "to taste" and a

"pinch."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Such vague wording is synonymous with
errors. I
can't make sense of this.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I decided to ask the person in charge of
the
kitchen to help me confirm the exact
amounts so
that I can focus on training
instead.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My sincerest apologies. I was
preoccupied with
the errors, and that
has led to my own...
erroneous
behavior...

She seems to regret her miscalculation,
so I tell
her that she should rest today
and we'll pick up
training tomorrow.
